/.h1: KIPIPL – M Sand, P Sand, Blue Metal and Ready Mix Concrete Supplier in Chennimalai
content: With a legacy dating back to 1990, KIPIPL stands as a pioneer in the sand and aggregates industry. Operating from a 100-acre mining campus in Murugantholuvu, Chennimalai, home to 10 million tons of premium blue metal reserves, we supply M Sand, P Sand, Blue Metal aggregates, K Blocks solid blocks, Ready Mix Concrete and Tile Fix Pro tile adhesive.

Our 150 TPH 4-stage sand manufacturing plant produces sand that meets IS standards. As the nearest blue metal quarry to Erode, we deliver within two hours across Chennimalai, Perundurai, Erode, Tiruppur and Namakkal districts.

content: With a legacy dating back to 1990, we stand as pioneers in the sand and aggregates industry, driven by innovation and a steadfast commitment to quality. /readymix.name: Ready Mix Concrete
/readymix.title: Ready Mix Concrete Supplier in Chennimalai & Erode | KIPIPL
/readymix.description: Order M10 to M40 Ready Mix Concrete from KIPIPL's twin shaft RMC plant, with boom pump support and delivery across Chennimalai, Perundurai and Erode.
content: Our Twin Shaft RMC Plant delivers premium-quality concrete using VSI-processed aggregates and high-grade M Sand. Engineered design mixes, efficient boom pump support and rapid delivery across Erode ensure reliable and precise concrete solutions for projects of every scale.
Every pour is monitored by experienced professionals and site coordinators to maintain superior strength, consistency and performance standards.
Grades available: M10, M15, M20, M25, M30, M35 and M40.

/kblocks.name: K Blocks
/kblocks.title: K Blocks Solid Block Supplier in Chennimalai | KIPIPL
/kblocks.description: Buy 4, 6 and 8 inch K Blocks solid blocks from KIPIPL, made on an automated high-pressure plant and delivered with crane support around Chennimalai.
content: We take pride in manufacturing premium-quality solid blocks designed for durability, strength and sustainable construction. Our fully automated production plant ensures precision, consistency and high performance in every block delivered.
Advanced high-pressure machinery, crane-supported delivery and rigorous compression testing guarantee reliable products for residential, commercial and infrastructure projects.
Sizes available: 4 inch, 6 inch and 8 inch solid blocks.

/tile-fixpro.name: Tile Fix Pro
/tile-fixpro.title: Tile Fix Pro Tile Adhesive | KIPIPL Chennimalai
/tile-fixpro.description: Tile Fix Pro is a cement-based tile adhesive for ceramic, vitrified, large-format and floor tiles. Available in 20 kg bags from KIPIPL, Chennimalai.
content: High-performance tile adhesive engineered for strong bonding, reliable holding strength and easy application across modern tile installations.

Tile Fix Pro – Latafix Floor Tile Adhesive 305 is a high-performance cement-based adhesive formulated for excellent bonding strength, water resistance and ease of application. Designed for ceramic, vitrified and large-format tiles, it ensures long-lasting and durable tile installations.
From residential spaces to commercial projects, Tile Fix Pro is designed to help professionals achieve a secure, precise and dependable tile installation.

people.name: Chandravathani Govindasamy
people.heading: From the MD's Desk
message: At Kannan Infra Projects India Pvt. Ltd., our journey of over three decades stands as a symbol of dedication, trust, and consistency. From our humble beginnings to becoming one of Tamil Nadu's most respected names in construction materials, our growth has always been guided by a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

Having witnessed the evolution of this industry for more than 35 years, I take pride in how we've blended experience with progress, balancing traditional values with modern practices. Every milestone we achieve reflects the hard work of our team and the trust of our valued clients.

people.name: Sowmesh Nithil Govindasamy
people.heading: From the Executive Director's Desk
message: At Kannan Infra Projects India Pvt. Ltd., we believe progress happens where people and technology meet with purpose. With a passion for innovation, I have focused on integrating computer vision-based automation and AI-driven systems to enhance performance, efficiency, and real-time decision-making. Our goal is not just to keep pace with change but to lead it, by building a smarter, data-driven future for KIPIPL. As we move forward, we remain committed to operational excellence, employee growth, and delivering superior value to our customers.

people.name: Rohith Nithil Govindasamy
people.heading: From the Director's Desk
message: At KIPIPL, execution is our strength and precision is our principle. Every project we undertake is driven by clear planning, teamwork, and a commitment to deliver on time with uncompromised quality. Our focus has always been on turning ideas into action, optimizing operations, improving productivity, and ensuring every process runs seamlessly from quarry to delivery. As we continue to grow, our goal remains simple: to execute efficiently, perform consistently, and build with integrity.
